Maya: Kicking off onboarding for Argos Systems — internal sync thread. Customer kickoff is Wed 3/31 10:00am PT. Primary success criteria: integration to staging, baseline latency validated, and first pilot queries working. I'll run the call. @Liam S. can you confirm SE cover and any runbook updates?

Liam S.: Yep, I can join. I'll bring logs, a short checklist, and the runbook updates. Planning a 1-week ingest cadence for their initial dataset.

Andre K.: I'll own the enablement deck and the live training plan. Quick Q: do we know Argos SSO/SCIM status? Priya mentioned Okta during intake.

Sophie R.: I'll own the customer success checklist + renewal-risk tracker. Tentative 90-day milestones: (1) Pilot acceptance, (2) Perf SLO met at 95th, (3) Feature adoption metric. Add data residency and compliance as potential risks.

onboard-bot: Task created: [1] Collect Okta metadata (assignee: Liam S.), [2] Prepare staging assertions (assignee: Liam S.), [3] Enablement deck (assignee: Andre K.), [4] CS 90d plan & survey (assignee: Sophie R.). Link: https://tasks.redwood/ARG-12345

Liam S.: I'll request Okta metadata from Priya and chase the sample dataset. Who will run post-kickoff feedback capture? I can send a quick technical survey but prefer CS own the follow-up.

Sophie R.: CS will own feedback. I'll draft a 1-question NPS + 2 technical satisfaction items (integration, latency). Draft by Mon COB, send after week 1.

Maya: Internal prep timeline: pre-kickoff doc by Tue COB, dry-run Wed 9:00am PT, customer kickoff Wed 10:00am PT. Post-call action items to be assigned and completed within 48h. I also added a renewal check-in reminder at 60d pre-term. :calendar: 

Andre K.: Training plan sketch: 90min live walkthrough + 30min office hours weekly for 3 weeks. Will reuse demo notebook at /docs/onboarding/argos-notebook.ipynb. Also prepping a short runbook snippet:

```
# Quick smoke test
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Maya: Thanks. Key risks: 1) Latency SLA (they need 95th < 200ms) — may require Dedicated routing. 2) PII/residency concerns — may push Private convo. Flagging both for post-kickoff escalation.

Liam S.: Small blocker: customer promised a masked sample dataset; we need it by Tue to validate parsing and latency bounds.

Maya: I'll follow up with Priya offline and update the thread. If no other blockers, I'll mark kickoff prep as green and invite stakeholders to the kickoff: Priya (Argos PM), Tom (Argos Eng), Nisha (Argos Security). :phone: 

Sophie R.: I'll prepare the 1-week success metrics dashboard template and share before dry-run.

Andre K.: Noted. Will prep slides and the short lab for the live session.

Maya: Great work team — see you at the dry-run. I'll post the pre-kickoff doc in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
